title: Rate-sync divergence between proxy and orchestrator causing opaque 503s for mixed-deployment tenants
creator: Aisha Malik
description: Multiple customers on hybrid tenant configurations (some routes on Hosted, some on Dedicated) observed opaque 503s and request drops for 10-20% of traffic between 2026-03-04 17:00 UTC and 2026-03-05 02:30 UTC. Symptoms: elevated 503s with no clear quota 429s, sudden increases in backend admission latency, and inconsistent per-tenant credit balances between proxy host view and orchestrator-led ledger. This ticket tracks triage, short-term mitigations, root cause, and a code-level reconciliation fix to prevent recurrence.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Provision hybrid tenant with routing rules split between hosted-api edge and dedicated-gpu pool
2) Generate sustained burst traffic (simulated client with 300 req/s for 5 minutes) that exercises both short-lived bursts and sustained credits
3) Observe proxy admission logs vs orchestrator ledger; look for delta in available_credit and last_epoch fields
4) When credit deltas exceed reconciliation threshold, proxy returns 503 due to admission gate thinking backend is overloaded even though orchestrator accepted requests
timeline_summary: 2026-03-04 16:45 UTC - alert from monitoring (spike in 503s). 2026-03-04 17:05 UTC - P0 declared, pagerduty. 2026-03-04 18:00 UTC - rollforward mitigation: temporarily reduce proxy admission aggressiveness for hybrid tenants. 2026-03-05 00:30 UTC - triage determines reconciliation window and sequence-number drift between proxy and orchestrator. 2026-03-06 to 2026-03-12 - engineering root-cause analysis and patch development. 2026-03-12 - hotfix PR opened and staging tests passing.
root_cause: Race between async credit_refresh updates and proxy-side burst-window advancement. When orchestrator applied a compacted ledger update (out-of-order sequence due to quorum replay), proxy hosts processed an intermediate state that omitted recently committed burst_tokens for certain tenants. Admission gate uses stale available_credit and defensive overload detection which returned opaque 503s instead of 429s. This was amplified for hybrid routing because two control paths apply different reconciliation heuristics (hosted edge used conservative windowing, dedicated orchestrator relied on eventual reconciliation).
mitigation_applied: Short term: lowered proxy admission sensitivity for hybrid tenants (config flag: admission.sensitivity=low) to reduce opaque 503s
Enabled telemetry to sample full ledger diffs for affected tenants for postmortem
Customer comms: notified top impacted tenants and offered credits; established dedicated support channel
code_fix_summary: Introduce monotonic 'ledger_version' checks and strict rebase logic in proxy: apply out-of-order ledger updates by comparing ledger_version and dropping updates that would regress available_credit. Add reconcile-on-miss path: if proxy detects available_credit < 0 but orchestrator reports positive balance, perform immediate fetch and linearized update. Also adjust admission gate to return 429 with detailed rate-limit metadata instead of 503 when credits are exhausted
qa_and_rollout_plan: 1) Unit tests for ledger_version and sequence regression paths. 2) Integration tests simulating out-of-order quorum replays. 3) Canary rollout to non-critical tenants (5% traffic) in staging, then 25% in prod over 6 hours. 4) Observe per-tenant credit delta histogram and 503/429 ratio. 5) Block rollout on regressions.
next_steps: Complete hotfix PR and get engineering review (PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/17481)
Schedule canary rollout window and runbook with SRE
Prepare postmortem doc and update quota design doc with explicit reconciliation guarantees (Confluence: /display/INF/ledger-reconciliation-v2)
Follow-up: add e2e test suite for hybrid tenant scenarios to the chaos lab
comments: 2026-03-05 — Aisha Malik: Initial triage concluded that outages correlate with hybrid routing. Captured traces and started immediate mitigation (lowered admission sensitivity). Notified CS and started customer comms.

2026-03-06 — Ethan Park: Reproduced sequence-number regression locally by injecting quorum replay. Confirmed proxy applied intermediate compacted ledger state that regressed available_credit. Drafting patch for ledger_version monotonic check.
2026-03-08 — Maya Chen (SRE): Added higher-fidelity sampling to admission traces and created dashboard for 503 vs 429 by tenant. Requested canary window and runbook for rollout.
2026-03-10 — Code review (PR 17481): feedback - add retry jitter to reconcile-on-miss to avoid stampeding reconcilers. Also ensure reconciliation path is idempotent.
2026-03-12 — Ethan Park: Hotfix PR opened and tests green in CI; staging canary scheduled for 2026-03-13 02:00 UTC. Will monitor for credit-delta regressions and customer 503 counts.
